sources.label: Morphe patches for the Grok Android app: bypass license check and download all I
sources.author: XXLC
patch_list: Bypass license check
Skip the Pairip license check when Grok starts.
Copy prompt

Add a post menu item with the copy icon that copies the current media prompt. It appears only for finished, non-moderated media (so the Retry action stays visible for failed or moderated generations) and only when the prompt is not empty.…
Disable telemetry
Block internal analytics events, Mixpanel and Hightouch payloads, and force Crashlytics collection off. Does not guarantee that every tracking connection is blocked.
Download all (library)
Add a button that downloads all media of the selected Imagine posts, keeping the original Download button.
Download all (post)
Add a menu item that downloads all media of the Imagine post being viewed, keeping the original Download item.
Download best video quality

Select the highest-quality video URL the app already received, keeping captions and music overlays and falling back to the original URL when needed. Images have a single URL and are unchanged. Not tested on a device.
Download file names

Name downloaded images and videos Grok_yyyyMMdd_HHmmss with milliseconds and a sequence number to avoid collisions within a process. Keeps file extensions and the existing deduplication. Not tested on a device.
Download folders

Save every download to Download/Grok/Pictures (images), Download/Grok/Videos (videos) or Download/Grok (other files) through MediaStore Downloads (or Download/Grok/... before Android 10). Not tested on a device.
Hide upgrade prompts
Hide the Imagine limit banner and the upgrade card in Settings, keeping usage data and subscription management. Compose changes are not tested on a device.
Ignore Team/Org Imagine lock

Make the app treat Imagine as allowed even when a Team/Org setting disables it, so the Imagine tab and entry points stay available. Only the app UI is changed: the server may still refuse Imagine requests, and the setting overridden is one…
Keep screen on

Keep the screen on for as long as Grok is in the foreground, including while reading chat. The flag is cleared when the activity pauses. Uses more battery, so it is off by default; not tested on a device.
Show Imagine tab

Always show the Imagine tab on the home screen, even when the home layout v2 flag hides it for new accounts or accounts that have not used Imagine recently. Does not change the Team/Org Imagine lock. Not tested on a device.
Skip delete confirmation

Delete Imagine images and videos, and bulk-delete library items, as soon as deletion is chosen, without the confirmation dialog (deleting a whole conversation still asks). Data is deleted permanently on the server with no undo. Off by defa…
